headline: Nevish Line Seesaws; Ground Shifts at Kuura Strand and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Three hours have turned the picture anew. On the Nevish Line the Colonials have clawed back a second post, cutting the Warden lead to six of eight strongpoints, with flag actions still being logged as this edition goes to press — Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother again the busiest grounds, and better than twelve thousand casualties counted there in a day. In Kuura Strand the Wardens are down to a single holding, one base now no-man's-land, Faden Point still the most contested shore. Weathered Expanse, the war's costliest front, has cost the Wardens further ground: one post stands against five Colonial and three demolished, Crow's Nest takes the heaviest pounding, and the casualty rate is still climbing. Linn Mercy, so lively at midday, has fallen silent in the past two hours. Marban Hollow remains split four posts to three about Checkpoint Bua, though quieter of late. Callahans Passage has flown no flag, yet its count runs past seven thousand losses a day and surges in the latest hours. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; no victor is declared.
